headline: I've been alone for years. What's keeping me here?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see the picture, but your hand found the one with everything still available.
Every tool is out on the table, within reach.
You said you have been alone for years and asked what keeps you here. The complete table is what catches me.
And yet you are still alone after the years you named.
Something stands between all that possibility and the relationship. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what that obstruction is…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The cards were face down, and you chose the one held by a single thing.
One rope circles one ankle. Nothing else is tied.
You asked what has kept you alone. This card brings me to the single rope.
Still, the relationship is absent, and the question feels held in place.
The thing that has hold of the meeting holds it tightly. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding the meeting…
c: You turned the Fool. The backs gave nothing away, yet you reached for the card in full light.
The full sun is high behind him.
You asked what keeps you here after years alone. The full light on the card holds my eye.
But the years have passed without the meeting you wanted.
Something turns up just where the open road would become connection. I don't think it started with you.
Now let's look at what's behind this…
